1. **प्रवेश प्रक्रिया:** KGMU में प्रवेश आमतौर पर आयोजित होने वाली प्रवेश परीक्षा (Entrance Exam) के माध्यम से होता है।
2. **योग्यता और जानकारी:** प्रवेश से संबंधित सटीक पात्रता मानदंड (Eligibility Criteria), आवेदन की तिथियां और चयन प्रक्रिया के लिए कृपया KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट के इस लिंक को देखें: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

entries.question: 50 mark hai
entries.answer:
KGMU में प्रवेश (Admission) के लिए कट-ऑफ और चयन की प्रक्रिया हर साल परीक्षा के स्तर और कुल सीटों के आधार पर बदलती रहती है। 50 अंक प्राप्त करने के बाद, आपको आगे के चरणों के लिए निम्नलिखित बातों का ध्यान रखना चाहिए:

1. **आधिकारिक काउंसलिंग (Counseling):** प्रवेश परीक्षा के बाद, विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा काउंसलिंग आयोजित की जाती है। केवल अंक प्राप्त करना ही पर्याप्त नहीं है, बल्कि आपको काउंसलिंग प्रक्रिया में भाग लेना अनिवार्य होता है।
2. **कट-ऑफ (Cut-off):** मैं यह नहीं बता सकता कि 50 अंक पर आपका चयन होगा या नहीं, क्योंकि यह उस वर्ष के अन्य छात्रों के प्रदर्शन और मेरिट लिस्ट पर निर्भर करता है। कृपया KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट के **'Admissions'** सेक्शन पर नजर रखें।
3. **नोटिस बोर्ड चेक करें:** आप समय-समय पर यहाँ आधिकारिक अपडेट देख सकती हैं: [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)
4. **काउंसलिंग शेड्यूल:** जब तक काउंसलिंग का आधिकारिक शेड्यूल जारी नहीं होता, तब तक मेरिट लिस्ट के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी नहीं मिल पाएगी।

**मेरी सलाह:** आप KGMU की वेबसाइट पर जाकर पिछले वर्षों के कट-ऑफ (यदि उपलब्ध हों) देख सकती हैं, जिससे आपको एक अंदाजा मिल जाएगा। कृपया अपना धैर्य बनाए रखें और आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर आने वाले काउंसलिंग नोटिस का इंतजार करें।

entries.question: To kya mera admission ho sakta hai
entries.answer:
मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप अपने एडमिशन को लेकर चिंतित हैं, लेकिन एक AI होने के नाते मैं यह नहीं बता सकता कि आपका सिलेक्शन होगा या नहीं। एडमिशन पूरी तरह से उस साल की **मेरिट लिस्ट** और **कट-ऑफ** पर निर्भर करता है, जो कई कारकों (जैसे कि कुल सीटें, परीक्षा का स्तर और अन्य छात्रों के अंक) पर आधारित होती है।

यहाँ कुछ बातें हैं जो आपको अभी करनी चाहिए:

1. **आधिकारिक सूचना की प्रतीक्षा करें:** KGMU अपनी वेबसाइट पर काउंसलिंग के लिए 'मेरिट लिस्ट' या 'कट-ऑफ लिस्ट' जारी करेगा। जब तक वह लिस्ट जारी नहीं होती, तब तक किसी भी निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना संभव नहीं है।
2. **काउंसलिंग में भाग लें:** यदि आपको काउंसलिंग के लिए बुलाया जाता है, तो उसमें जरूर शामिल हों। कई बार अगर सीटें खाली रहती हैं या कैटेगरी के अनुसार मेरिट कम होती है, तो भी मौके मिल जाते हैं।
3. **वेबसाइट पर अपडेट रहें:** कृपया नियमित रूप से इस लिंक को चेक करती रहें: [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)
4. **कैटेगरी का प्रभाव:** यदि आप किसी विशेष आरक्षित श्रेणी (Reserved Category) से हैं, तो कट-ऑफ सामान्य (General) श्रेणी से अलग हो सकती है। काउंसलिंग के दौरान अपने सभी जरूरी दस्तावेज तैयार रखें।

**निष्कर्ष:** अभी हार न मानें। जब तक आधिकारिक काउंसलिंग की प्रक्रिया या रिजल्ट की फाइनल मेरिट लिस्ट नहीं आ जाती, तब तक इंतजार करना ही सही विकल्प है। 

क्या आपको अपनी कैटेगरी या किसी अन्य जानकारी के बारे में और कुछ पूछना है?

entries.question: Lari me dikhana h marij ko
entries.answer:
Lari Cardiology (LARI) mein dikhane ke liye aapko online ya offline registration karwana anivarya (mandatory) hai. 

**OPD mein dikhane ke liye ye steps follow karein:**

1.  **Online Registration (Recommended):** 
    *   Website [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar ya 'ABHA/Health Care App' ke madhyam se appointment book karein.
    *   Iske liye ₹50 ka OPD slip shulk (fee) dena hoga.
2.  **Walk-in Registration:** 
    *   Aap sidhe KGMU aakar bhi parchi banwa sakte hain. Iske liye apna **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** saath layein. 
    *   Token lene ke baad ₹50 ka shulk jama karke OPD slip prapt karein.
3.  **Samay (Timings):** 
    *   OPD registration counter subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak khula rehta hai. Dopehar 1 baje counter band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna zaruri hai.
4.  **Zaruri Suchna:**
    *   Agar marij Lucknow se bahar ka hai, toh sambhandhit vibhag (Cardiology) ka **valid referral** saath zaroor layein.
    *   Emergency sthiti mein seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** jayein. Cardiology emergency ke liye pehle Trauma Centre mein stabilize hona padta hai, phir LARI transfer kiya jata hai.

**Sampark (Contact):**
*   Lari Cardiology PRO Office: 9415099528
*   KGMU Help Line: 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333

*Kripya chat mein koi bhi personal medical record ya Aadhaar number share na karein.*

entries.question: Lari opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Lari Cardiology OPD at KGMU, please follow one of the methods below. Please note that online registration is mandatory.

### **Booking Methods**
*   **Online (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, and follow the steps to book your appointment.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Counter:** The Parchi/ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If it is a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre** through Gate 14. For cardiology-specific emergencies, stabilize at the Trauma Centre first, and you will be transferred to LARI Cardiology accordingly.

For further assistance, you may contact the **Lari Cardiology PRO Office** at **9415099528**.

*Disclaimer: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.*

*   "Uttar Pradesh" rajya select karein aur phir "KGMU" chunein.

*   Aap `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

* **Kya karein:** KGMU ke **PRO Office (9415007710)** jayein aur wahan ke staff se poochein ki "KGMU mein kaun si outsourcing agency staff supply karti hai?" Un agencies ka naam aur office address pata karke wahan apna CV (Resume) jama karein.

### 2. Sewayojan Portal (Uttar Pradesh Government)
UP ke sarkari vibhagon aur autonomous sansthanon (jaise KGMU) mein jab bhi contractual bharti hoti hai, toh woh **[sewayojan.up.nic.in](https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/)** par upload ki jati hai.
* **Kya karein:** Is portal par apni profile banayein, apne 10th/12th ke marks aur certificates (Red Cross, LIC) zaroor upload karein. Jab bhi "Lucknow" district mein "Medical" sector mein koi vacancy aayegi, aapko notification mil jayega.

### 3. Resume (CV) ko Update Karein
Aapke paas jo certificates hain (Red Cross, LIC, Mayor award), ye aapke **'Soft Skills'** aur **'Social Responsibility'** ko dikhate hain.
* **Resume mein aise likhein:** 
    * "Certified by Red Cross Society (First Aid/Disaster Management skills)" - Ye dikhata hai ki aap emergency mein kaam kar sakte hain.
    * "Appreciated by Mayor of Lucknow" - Ye dikhata hai ki aap ek disciplined aur kaam ke prati samarpi vyakti hain.
* Kisi computer shop se ek achha professional Resume banwayein jisme ye sab highlight ho.

### 4. Networking (KGMU Campus)
KGMU ek bada campus hai.
* **Kya karein:** Kabhi kabhi departments mein direct recruitment ki charcha hoti hai. Aap campus ke 'Administration Block' ya 'Dean Office' ke aas-paas ke clerks ya staff se polite hokar baat karein aur poochein ki kya koi file vacancy ke liye process mein hai?

### 5. Private Hospitals mein koshish
KGMU ke paas hi kai bade private hospitals hain (Sahara, Medanta, Apollo, ya local nursing homes). 
* Aapka 78% aur 84% ka record achha hai. Aap in private hospitals mein **"Front Desk"** ya **"Billing/Admin"** ke liye apply karein. Wahan aapka LIC ka certificate (communication skills) aur Red Cross ka certificate (basic medical knowledge) bahut kaam aayega.

**Meri Salah:** 
Agli baar jab aap Lucknow mein hon, toh ek din nikal kar **KGMU ke PRO Office** zaroor jayein. Wahan se aapko asli ground-level jankari milegi ki kaun si agency ke paas vacancy hai. 

**Ek warning:** Kabhi bhi kisi ko naukri ke naam par paise mat dena. KGMU mein bharti hamesha merit ya agency ke interview se hoti hai.

Aapke andar jo ye **"swabhimaan"** aur **"mehnat karne ka jazba"** hai, wahi aapko aage lekar jayega. KGMU ya kisi bhi bade sansthan mein jab aap apni kabiliyat (merit) ke dam par jagah banayenge, toh uski khushi aur samman alag hi hoga.

Aapke paas jo certificates hain, woh dikhate hain ki aapne apne samay ka sahi upyog kiya hai aur samajik karya mein bhi ruchi li hai. **Isi imandari ke sath apne raste par chalte rahiye.**

**Agla kadam jo aap utha sakte hain:**
1. **Computer Typing Skill:** Agar aapne abhi tak nahi kiya hai, toh Hindi aur English typing ka thoda abhyas shuru kar dein. Office ki jobs mein ye bahut kaam aata hai.

3. **Imandari se apply karein:** Kisi bhi shortcut ke chakkar mein padne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

entries.question: Kya letter
entries.answer:
Jab aap kisi office ya hospital mein naukri ke liye apna Resume (CV) jama karne jaate hain, toh uske saath ek **"Cover Letter"** (ya Application Letter) lagana bahut zaroori hota hai. Ye letter bataata hai ki aap kaun hain, aapne kya padhai ki hai aur aap naukri kyun chahte hain.

Yeh ek professional format hai jise aap apne hisaab se likh sakte hain:

***

**SEVA MEIN,**
**SHRIMAN PRASHASAN ADHIKARI (ADMINISTRATION OFFICER),**
**KING GEORGE’S MEDICAL UNIVERSITY (KGMU),**
**LUCKNOW.**

**VISHAY: OFFICE/ADMINISTRATIVE POST KE LIYE AAVEDAN.**

**MAHODAY,**

Main [Aapka Naam] Lucknow ka niwasi hoon. Maine apni 12th ki padhai [School ka naam] se 78% ankon ke saath aur 10th ki padhai 84% ankon ke saath poori ki hai. 

Main ek mehanti aur imandaar ummidwar hoon. Mere paas Red Cross Society ka certificate aur LIC ka certificate hai, jisse mujhe logon se baat karne (communication) aur emergency situations ko handle karne ka anubhav hai. Mujhe Lucknow ki Mayor Smt. Sanyukta Bhatia ji dwara bhi prashansa patra (certificate) diya gaya hai, jo meri samajik aur vyaktigat imandari ko darshata hai.

Main KGMU jaise pratishthit sansthan mein ek zimmedar vyakti ke roop mein kaam karne ka ichhuk hoon. Agar aapke yahan koi bhi Administrative ya Support Staff ki vacancy ho, toh kripya mujhe seva ka avsar dein.

Main apna Resume aur certificates is patra ke saath sanlagn (attach) kar raha hoon.

**DHANYAVAD.**

**BHAVDIYA,**
[Aapka Naam]
[Aapka Mobile Number]
[Aapka Address]

***

### Is letter ko kaise use karein:
1. **Ek Saaf Kagaz par:** Isse ek saaf A4 size ke paper par likhein ya print nikalwayein.
2. **Attachments:** Is letter ke peeche apne 10th, 12th ki marksheet aur apne sabhi certificates (Red Cross, LIC, Mayor certificate) ki **photocopy** zaroor lagayein.
3. **File Folder:** Sabhi kagazon ko ek achhi file ya folder mein lagayein.
4. **Kahan dein:** Jab aap KGMU ke PRO office ya kisi department mein jayein, toh wahan ke babu (clerk) ko bolein, "Sir, main naukri ke liye aavedan dena chahta hoon, kya main apna resume yahan jama kar sakta hoon?"

**Ek aur salah:** Jab bhi aap ye letter jama karne jayein, toh apni original marksheet aur certificates apne saath rakhein (verification ke liye).

Ab aapka Resume pehle se kahin zyada majboot ho gaya hai. Aapko apne Resume mein **"Technical Skills"** ka ek alag section banana chahiye.

### Apne Resume mein ye zaroor likhein:

*   **Computer Skills:**
    *   Advance Diploma in Computer Applications (ADCA).
    *   MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) mein proficiency.
    *   Data Entry aur Typing ka accha anubhav.
    *   Internet aur Email handling.

### Aapke liye ab sahi strategy:

1.  **Typing Speed:** Agar aapki Hindi/English typing speed acchi hai, toh use apne resume mein zaroor mention karein (e.g., "Hindi Typing: 30 WPM, English Typing: 40 WPM"). Ye administrative jobs ke liye sabse important skill hai.
2.  **KGMU PRO Office ka visit:** Jab aap KGMU ke PRO office jayein, toh **"Computer Operator"** ya **"Data Entry"** ki vacancy ke baare mein specifically poochein. Kyunki aapke paas ADCA hai, aap in posts ke liye perfect hain.
3.  **Departmental Visit:** KGMU mein bahut saare departments hain (jaise Pathology, Anatomy, etc.). Har department mein ek office hota hai jahan data entry ka kaam hota hai. Aap wahan ke **"Office Superintendent"** ya **"Head of Department (HOD)"** ke office mein jakar apna resume de sakte hain.
4.  **Private Medical Colleges/Labs:** Lucknow mein bahut saare Diagnostic Centers aur private hospitals hain. ADCA + aapke certificates ke dam par aap wahan **"Receptionist"** ya **"Billing Executive"** ki post par turant naukri paa sakte hain.

**Ek kaam kijiye:**
Aap apna ek accha sa **"Resume"** taiyar kariye jisme ye saari cheezein (10th, 12th, ADCA, Certificates) likhi hon. 

*   Kya aapne apne Resume mein ADCA ko sabse upar highlight kiya hai?
*   Agar aapko Resume ka format chahiye ki kaise likhein, toh batayein, main aapko ek professional format bana kar de sakta hoon jise aap print karwa sakein.

entries.question: Nhi mai kha jayu kgmu papa bol rha tha aise koi nhi leta nokri
entries.answer:
Papa ki baat ek had tak sahi hai—KGMU mein seedhe jaakar "naukri dedo" bolne se koi naukri nahi deta, kyunki sarkari ya bade sansthanon mein bharti ke kuch niyam hote hain. Lekin, **"koi nahi leta"** ka matlab ye nahi hai ki aap koshish hi na karein.

Aapko naukri lene ka **tareeka** badalna hoga. KGMU mein naukri pane ke 3 sahi raaste ye hain:

### 1. Outsourcing Agencies (Sabse realistic raasta)
KGMU mein clerical aur computer ka kaam karne wale 80% log **'Outsourcing Agencies'** ke dwara rakhe jaate hain. Ye agency wale university se contract lete hain aur staff supply karte hain.
*   **Kaise pata karein:** KGMU ke PRO office mein jaakar bas itna poochein: *"Sir, yahan kaun si outsourcing agency kaam kar rahi hai?"* unka office address le lein aur wahan apna resume dein. Jab bhi unhe computer operator ki zaroorat hogi, woh aapko call karenge.

### 2. Sewayojan Portal (Sarkari raasta)
UP Sarkar ka **[sewayojan.up.nic.in](https://sewayojan.up.nic.in/)** portal check karte rahiye. Jab KGMU mein koi vacancy aati hai, toh wahan se bhi log liye jaate hain. Ye bilkul safe aur sahi raasta hai.

### 3. "Direct" naukri nahi, "Experience" ke liye jayein
Agar papa keh rahe hain ki koi nahi leta, toh aap unhe bolen ki aap "naukri mangne" nahi, balki **"information lene"** ja rahe hain. 
*   Aap campus mein kisi bhi department ke **Office** mein jayein. Wahan ke clerk se poochein: *"Sir, mujhe computer ka kaam aata hai (ADCA kiya hai), kya yahan koi project chal raha hai jisme data entry operator ki zaroorat ho?"*
*   Kai baar professors ke paas research projects hote hain jisme unhe computer chalane wale ladkon ki zaroorat hoti hai. Wo project-based naukri hoti hai, jo aasaani se mil jati hai.

### Papa ko kaise samjhayein?
Aap papa se kahein: *"Papa, main naukri mangne nahi, apna resume register karwane aur vacancies ka pata karne ja raha hoon. Agar main ghar baithunga toh kabhi pata nahi chalega. Ek baar koshish karne mein kya harj hai?"*

**Meri advice:**
Aap KGMU ke **PRO Office (Gate 2 ke paas)** jayein. Wahan ka kaam hi yahi hai ki bahar se aane wale logon ko sahi jaankari dein. Unse poochein ki "Contractual recruitment" ka process kya hai. 

**Ek aur baat:**
Lucknow mein bahut saare **Diagnostic Centers aur Pathology Labs** hain (jaise Lal PathLabs, ya local bade centers). Wahan ADCA walon ki bahut maang hoti hai. Wahan try kariye, wahan se kaam shuru kijiye. Jab ek baar experience ho jayega, tab KGMU mein apply karna aur bhi aasaan ho jayega.

Aapke paas ADCA hai, ye bahut badi baat hai. Apni skills par bharosa rakhein. Kya aapne kabhi kisi private lab ya hospital mein resume diya hai?

entries.question: Salary
entries.answer:
KGMU mein agar aapko **Contractual (Outsourcing)** ya **Project-based** naukri milti hai, toh salary aapki post aur kaam ke hisaab se hoti hai. Main aapko ek andaza (estimate) de raha hoon ki Lucknow mein aise kaam ke liye kya salary milti hai:

### 1. Data Entry Operator / Office Assistant
*   **Expected Salary:** ₹12,000 se ₹18,000 ke beech.
*   Ye salary aapke kaam ke ghante (working hours) aur agency ke contract par depend karti hai.
*   Sarkari outsourcing mein **EPF (Provident Fund)** aur **ESI (Medical facility)** ka paisa kat kar milta hai, jo aapke liye achha hota hai.

### 2. Research Project (Projects ke andar)
*   Agar aap kisi Professor ke research project mein rakhe jaate hain, toh salary ₹15,000 se ₹25,000 tak bhi ho sakti hai. Ye project ke fund par nirbhar karta hai.

### 3. Private Lab ya Hospital (Lucknow mein)
*   Agar aap kisi bade diagnostic center mein join karte hain, toh shuruat ₹10,000 se ₹15,000 ke beech hoti hai.
*   **Faida:** Yahan aapko "Experience" milta hai. Ek saal ka experience lene ke baad aap apni salary ₹20,000+ tak badhwa sakte hain.

---

### **Zaroori Baat (Salary ko lekar):**
*   **Pehli Naukri:** Jab aap shuruat kar rahe hain, toh sirf salary mat dekhiye. Ye dekhiye ki aapko **"Sikhne"** ko kya mil raha hai. KGMU ka naam aapke resume par hona, aage chal kar aapko badi naukri dilwane mein madad karega.
*   **Salary kaise badhegi:** Aapne ADCA kiya hai, toh koshish karein ki **Excel (Advanced Excel)** aur **Tally** (agar ho sake toh) bhi seekh lein. Agar aapko Excel mein formula lagana aur data manage karna aa gaya, toh aap ki demand aur salary dono badh jayengi.

**Papa ko bolne ke liye:**
Jab aap papa se baat karein, toh unhe ye mat bolein ki "main naukri mangne ja raha hoon". Unhe bolein: *"Papa, main wahan ja raha hoon taaki mujhe pata chale ki wahan kaam kaise milta hai aur salary kitni milti hai. Main apna resume wahan ke database mein dalwa dunga, toh jab bhi vacancy aayegi, wo mujhe call karenge."*

**Ek kaam kariye:** Aaj hi apne resume ka print nikalwaiye aur kal subah 10 baje KGMU ke **PRO Office** ya kisi bade department mein jayiye. 

Kya aapne abhi tak apna Resume computer par type kar liya hai? Agar nahi, toh kisi bhi cyber cafe par jaakar upar wala format type karwa lijiye. 10-20 rupaye lagenge, par ye aapka pehla kadam hoga!

entries.question: Hnn pehle kgmu me mai private ki trh kaam karuna phr gov job kar lunga mera sapna h doctor banne ka lkn ghr ki fincial conditions aisi nhi h ki mai padi aur 4 bhai bhn aur h
entries.answer:
Aapki baatein sunkar bahut samman mehsoos ho raha hai. Aapke haalaat aur aapka jazba (dream) dono hi bahut bade hain. 4 bhai-behen ki zimmedari aur doctor banne ka sapna—ye dikhata hai ki aap ek bahut hi zimmedar aur mehanti insaan hain.

KGMU jaise jagah par kaam karna aapke sapne ke liye sabse sahi kadam hai, kyunki wahan rehte hue aapko **mahaul (environment)** milega, aap doctors ko kaam karte dekhenge aur aapko medical field ki baarikiyan samajh aayengi.

### Aapke sapne aur aapki situation ke liye meri kuch khaas salah:

**1. "Work and Study" ka model:**
KGMU mein agar aapko Data Entry ya Office assistant ki job milti hai, toh koshish karein ki wo **Day shift** mein ho. Shaam ko aap apni padhai (NEET ya jo bhi aapka target hai) ke liye waqt nikaal sakte hain. KGMU mein aise bahut se log hain jo pehle chhote kaam karte the aur aaj bade positions par hain.

**2. KGMU Library ka faida:**
KGMU mein ek bahut badi library hai. Jab aap wahan kaam karenge, toh aapke liye wahan ke senior students aur faculty se baat karna aasaan ho jayega. Wo log aapko sahi guide kar sakte hain ki kam paise mein doctor ya medical field mein kaise aage badhein.

**3. Financial Condition aur Scholarship:**
Agar aapka sapna doctor banne ka hai, toh sirf naukri hi raasta nahi hai. Jab aap KGMU mein honge, toh aap **"E-Library"** aur **"National Scholarship Portal"** (jo hamare records mein bhi hai) ke baare mein wahan ke office se pata kar sakte hain. Kai baar government ki aisi schemes hoti hain jo aap jaise mehanti students ki fees tak utha leti hain.

**4. Himmat mat haariye:**
Aapne kaha ki typing speed dheemi hai—koi baat nahi! Ek mahine tak rozana 1 ghanta practice kariye, speed wapas aa jayegi. Aapne ADCA kiya hai, ye aapki sabse badi taqat hai. Computer par aapki pakad aapko office mein jaldi upar le jayegi.

**Ek suggestion:**
Jab aap KGMU mein jayein, toh sirf naukri mat dhoondhein, wahan ke **"Medical Social Worker"** ya **"Patient Welfare Office"** (jinka number hamare system mein hai) ke baare mein bhi jaankari lein. Wahan ke log aksar zarooratmand logon ki madad karte hain aur aapko sahi raasta dikha sakte hain.

**Aapke liye ek chota sa sujhaav:**
Jab bhi aap thake hue mehsoos karein ya lage ki ghar ki zimmedariyan zyada hain, toh bas ye yaad rakhiyega ki aap KGMU mein reh kar apne sapne ke sabse kareeb hain. Dheere-dheere hi sahi, par aap sahi disha mein chal rahe hain.

Kya aapne abhi tak apna Resume taiyar kar liya hai? Agar aapko resume mein kuch aur add karwana ho (jaise ki aapki koi aur khas skill), toh batayein, main aapki poori madad karunga. Aap akele nahi hain!

entries.question: Maine cnet ka paper diya tha, 66 no h 21484 rank obc h kgmu chaiye tha private ki fee ke paise nhi hai
entries.answer:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki aap kitne pareshaan hain. CNET (Common Nursing Entrance Test) mein 66 marks aur 21484 rank ke saath KGMU mein government seat milna bahut mushkil hai, aur private college ki fees itni zyada hoti hai ki middle-class ya gareeb parivar ke liye use afford karna namumkin hota hai.

Lekin, **aapka sapna khatam nahi hua hai.** Nursing ya Medical line mein aane ke liye sirf ek hi raasta nahi hota. Aapke liye abhi ye options hain:

### 1. "General Nursing & Midwifery" (GNM) aur ANM
Agar aapke paas BSc Nursing ki fees nahi hai, toh GNM ya ANM ka option dekhein.
*   GNM ka course BSc Nursing se sasta hota hai.
*   Kai baar government hospitals mein GNM ki training ke saath-saath stipends (kuch paise) bhi milte hain.
*   GNM karne ke baad bhi aap 'Staff Nurse' ban sakte hain aur baad mein job karte-karte apni BSc Nursing puri kar sakte hain.

### 2. KGMU mein "Work-Study" ka mauka
Aapne ADCA kiya hai, ye aapki sabse badi asset hai. KGMU mein bahut saare **Research Projects** hote hain (jaise ki ICMR ya government ke projects). 
*   In projects mein computer operators ki zaroorat hoti hai. 
*   Agar aap wahan as a **Project Assistant/Data Entry Operator** lag jaate hain, toh aapko salary bhi milegi aur aap doctors ke beech mein rahenge. 
*   Wahan kaam karte-karte aapko ye pata chal jayega ki medical field mein scholarship kaise milti hai aur agle saal entrance ki taiyari kaise karni hai.

### 3. Scholarship ka raasta (National Scholarship Portal)
Agar aap kisi bhi tarah se admission le paate hain (chaise bhi), toh **National Scholarship Portal (NSP)** par aap jaise students ke liye 100% tak fees refund ki scheme hoti hai. 
*   Jab aap KGMU ya kisi bhi college mein admission lene jayein, toh wahan ke **"Scholarship Cell"** mein zaroor baat karein. Unhe apni financial condition batayein.

### 4. Agle saal ki taiyari (NEET ya CNET)
Agar is saal admission nahi ho pa raha, toh haar mat maaniye. 
*   Aap abhi KGMU mein kisi bhi tarah ki contractual job dhoondhein. 
*   Job ke saath-saath roz 3-4 ghante padhai karein. 
*   KGMU ki library aur wahan ke mahaul ka fayda uthayein. Jab aap wahan kaam karenge, toh aapko padhne ke liye motivation milega.

### Meri aapko ek bahut zaroori advice:
Aapne **CNET** ka paper diya, iska matlab aap padhne mein acche hain. 66 marks laana koi choti baat nahi hai. 
*   **Abhi kya karein:** KGMU ke **PRO Office** ya **Examination Cell** mein jakar ye mat poochein ki "mera admission hoga ya nahi", balki ye poochein ki "Kya yahan koi **Skill-based job** ya **Data entry** ki vacancy hai?"
*   Aapka aim abhi **"Paisa kamana"** aur **"Medical mahaul mein rehna"** hona chahiye. Jab aap wahan kaam karenge, toh aapko aise log milenge jo aapko bata payenge ki aap bina paise ke nursing ya medical course kaise kar sakte hain.

**Papa se kya kahein:**
"Papa, main admission ke liye zidd nahi karunga kyunki mujhe pata hai paise nahi hain. Lekin main KGMU mein as a computer operator kaam dhoondh raha hoon. Wahan rehkar main kaam bhi seekhunga, paise bhi kamaunga aur agle saal exam ki taiyari bhi kar lunga."

Aap bahut bahadur hain ki aap 4 bhai-behenon ki zimmedari samajh rahe hain. **Kya aapke paas CNET ka admit card ya result ka printout hai?** Use sambhal kar rakhein, wo aapka pehla kadam hai. 

Kya aapne Lucknow mein kisi aur college ke baare mein socha hai jahan fees kam ho?

entries.question: मुझे ऑनलाइन रेजिटेशन करना है
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों से अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं:

1.  **ORS (Online Registration System):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं। वहां 'Uttar Pradesh' राज्य और 'KGMU' अस्पताल चुनें। इसके बाद विभाग, तारीख और समय चुनकर अपनी जानकारी भरें और ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करें।
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** आप अपने मोबाइल नंबर और OTP का उपयोग करके पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं और ORS की तरह ही प्रक्रिया पूरी कर सकते हैं।
3.  **SMS द्वारा:** आप `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर `8887019134` पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।
4.  **वॉक-इन (Walk-in):** आप सीधे अस्पताल आकर भी आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर के जरिए टोकन ले सकते हैं। इसके लिए भी ₹50 का शुल्क लगता है।

**ध्यान दें:**
*   OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक, और शनिवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक है।
*   रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
*   बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए एक वैध रेफरल (Referral) साथ लाना अनिवार्य है।
*   असुविधा से बचने के लिए पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना बेहतर है।

**सुरक्षा सलाह:** कृपया अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी जानकारी या व्यक्तिगत विवरण (जैसे आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर) इस चैट में साझा न करें। यदि आपको कोई चिकित्सीय समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU के OPD में डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

Is letter mein maine aapki paristhiti (financial condition) ko bahut hi vinamra aur professional tareeke se likha hai, taaki padhne wale officer par aapki imaandari ka asar pade.

---

### **APPLICATION FORMAT**

**SEVA MEIN,**

Mera sapna medical field mein aage badhne ka hai, aur KGMU jaise pratishthit sansthan mein kaam karke main na sirf apne parivar ki madad karna chahta hoon, balki is mahaul se seekhkar apne bhavishya ko bhi sudharna chahta hoon.

Main ek mehanti aur dridh-nischayi vyakti hoon. Agar aapke sansthan mein Computer Operator, Data Entry ya kisi bhi administrative post par koi vacancy ho, toh kripya mujhe seva ka avsar pradan karein. Aapki ye madad mere parivar ke liye bahut badi sahara hogi.

Main is patra ke saath apne shaikshik aur takniki praman-patron ki photocopy sanlagn kar raha hoon.

**DHANYAVAD.**

**BHAVDIYA,**

**(Signature)**
**[APNA NAAM]**
**MOBILE NO:** [Apna Number]
**DATE:** [Aaj ki Date]

### **Kuch zaroori baatein (Isse zaroor padhein):**

2.  **Kahan jana hai:** KGMU mein **Gate No. 1 (Admin/Academic)** ya **Gate No. 2 (Main Hospital)** ke paas jo Administrative block hai, wahan jayein. Wahan ke kisi bhi bade clerk ya officer ko ye letter pakdayein.
3.  **Himmat mat haarna:** Kai baar wahan ke log kehte hain "abhi vacancy nahi hai", toh aap unse kehna: *"Sir, please mera resume rakh lijiye, agar kabhi bhi koi emergency ya project-based kaam aaye, toh mujhe yaad kijiyega."*
4.  **Ek aur rasta:** KGMU mein bahut saare **"Outsourcing Agencies"** (jaise Purvanchal, ya anya) kaam karti hain. Unke office KGMU ke andar ya aas-paas hote hain. Unse bhi zaroor milein, kyunki wo seedhe bharti karte hain.

Aapka jazba hi aapko kamyab banayega. Aapne apne ghar ke liye jo zimmedari uthayi hai, bhagwan aapki zaroor sunenge. Kal subah poore confidence ke saath jayiye aur ye letter dijiye. **Best of luck!**

entries.question: Bhai certificate kho gya h jha se maine sikha tha wha se dubarabanwana padega
entries.answer:
Koi baat nahi, ghabrao mat. Certificate kho gaya hai toh ye koi bahut badi musibat nahi hai. Iska hal nikal jayega.

**Abhi aapko ye karna chahiye:**

1.  **Institute jao:** Jaha se aapne ADCA kiya tha, wahan jao aur unhe bolo ki "Sir, mera certificate kho gaya hai, mujhe uski duplicate copy ya ek 'Bonafide Certificate' (jo ye likh kar de ki aapne wahan se course kiya hai) chahiye." Wo log aasani se bana kar de denge.
2.  **Tab tak kya karein:** Jab tak naya certificate nahi milta, tab tak **"Self-Declaration"** ka istemal karo. 
    *   Apne letter/resume mein niche ek line likh do: *"Mera ADCA ka certificate filhal kho gaya hai, jiske liye maine institute mein apply kar diya hai. Zarurat padne par main iski copy prastut kar dunga."* 
    *   Isse aapka kaam nahi rukega aur aapki imaandari bhi dikhegi.
3.  **Resume mein "Skills" likho:** Certificate nahi hai toh kya hua, **"Skills"** toh aapke dimaag mein hain na? Resume mein ye points zaroor likhna:
    *   **Computer Skills:** MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet Browsing, Data Entry.
    *   **Typing:** Hindi aur English typing ka gyan.
    *   **Soft Skills:** Hardworking, Honest, Quick Learner.

**Ek important baat:**
KGMU mein ya kisi bhi office mein jab aap naukri mangne jaoge, toh aapka **"Confidence"** aur **"Kaam karne ka tarika"** certificate se zyada mainne rakhta hai. 

**Kal aapko ye karna hai:**
*   Agar institute paas hai, toh kal wahan jaakar duplicate certificate ke liye request daal do.
*   Tab tak, upar wala letter print karwao aur usme bas "ADCA" mention kar do. 
*   Jab aap officer ke paas jao, toh bolna: *"Sir, maine ADCA kiya hai, certificate ka process chal raha hai, par main typing aur computer ka kaam abhi kar sakta hoon."*

**Ek aur advice:**
Aapke papa lohar (blacksmith) hain, agar aapko kabhi wahan kaam mein bhi help karni pade, toh sharmaana mat. Lekin apna focus naukri par rakho. 

Kya aapne apne computer par practice shuru ki? Agar aapke paas ghar par computer nahi hai, toh kisi dost ke yahan ya cyber cafe par 1 ghanta typing ki practice zaroor karo. 

**Himmat mat haaro, aapka sapna doctor banne ka hai, aur wo tabhi pura hoga jab aap musibaton se ladna seekhoge. Main aapke saath hoon!**

entries.question: Bhai papa kh rhe h time waste hoga aise nokri nhi milti
entries.answer:
Bhai, papa ki baat apni jagah bilkul sahi hai kyunki wo aapki chinta kar rahe hain. Unhone zindgi dekhi hai aur wo nahi chahte ki aapka waqt kharab ho. Lekin aapko unhe ek baat samjhane ki zaroorat hai:

**"Papa, main wahan waqt barbad karne nahi, apni kismat aur mehnat ko ek mauka dene ja raha hoon."**

Aap unhe ye 3 points shanti se samjhaiye:

1.  **Ye "Time Waste" nahi, "Career ki shuruat" hai:** KGMU Lucknow ka sabse bada aur prestigious sansthan hai. Agar wahan ek baar aapki file administrative office mein chali gayi, toh wo aapke database mein save ho jaati hai. Jab bhi koi vacancy niklegi, aapka naam wahan pehle se hoga. Ye "Networking" hai, waqt ki barbadi nahi.
2.  **Aapka "All-UP Level" ka talent:** Papa ko bataiye ki aapne sirf ek competition nahi jeeta, balki pure UP ke students ko haraya hai. Aapka ye talent aapko bheed se alag karta hai. Jab aap apna certificate dikhayenge, toh bade-bade officers bhi aapki mehnat ki tareef karenge. Ye cheez aapka confidence badhayegi, chahe naukri mile ya na mile.
3.  **Ek mauka, ek nayi raah:** Agar aap ghar baithe rahenge, toh koi aapko ghar aakar naukri nahi dega. KGMU mein jaakar aapko pata chalega ki wahan kaam kaise hota hai, interview kaise hote hain aur log kaise select hote hain. Ye seekhna hi aapke agle interview ke liye kaam aayega.

### **Papa ko raazi karne ka tarika:**

Aap unse sirf itna kaho:
*"Papa, aap mujh par bharosa rakhte ho, isliye main aapko bataya. Main sirf ek din (kuch ghante) lagakar wahan jana chahta hoon. Agar nahi hua, toh main wapas aa jaunga aur aapki har baat manunga. Par agar main koshish hi nahi karunga, toh mujhe hamesha afsos rahega ki maine mauka chhod diya. Mujhe bas ek baar apni mehnat dikhane ka mauka dijiye."*

**Ek sachai suno:**
Bahut saare log jo aaj bade padon par hain, unhone bhi aise hi "ek chhota sa application" jama karke shuruat ki thi. 

**Mera sujhav:**
Aap ek kaam karo. Kal subah jaao, apna kaam karke waapas aa jao. Ghar aakar papa ko batao ki aapne kahan-kahan baat ki aur kya seekha. Jab papa dekhenge ki aapne zimmedari se kaam kiya hai aur sahi jagah file jama ki hai, toh wo khud agli baar aapko support karenge.

**Darro mat.** Papa ko bas aapki chinta hai. Unhe proof karke dikhao ki aap waqt barbad nahi kar rahe, balki apni zindagi ko behtar banane ki ladai lad rahe ho. 

**Jao, apni mehnat par bharosa rakho!** Kuch aur help chahiye ho toh main yahin hoon.

entries.question: Ors.gov.in kya hai
entries.answer:
**ORS (Online Registration System)**, jiska link **ors.gov.in** hai, Bharat Sarkar ka ek digital platform hai jiske madhyam se aap desh ke bade sarkari aspatalon (jaise KGMU) mein OPD appointment ke liye ghar baithe online registration aur booking kar sakte hain.

KGMU mein appointment lene ke liye iska istemal kaise karein:

1.  **Website par jayein:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein.
2.  **State aur Hospital chunein:** State mein "Uttar Pradesh" aur phir hospital ki list mein "King George's Medical University (KGMU)" ko select karein.
3.  **Appointment Book karein:** "New Appointment" par click karein, apna विभाग (Department) aur date chunein.
4.  **Patient Details:** Apna mobile number aur Aadhaar card ki jankari daalein (OTP verify karein).
5.  **Payment:** Appointment ke liye ₹50 ka online shulk (fee) bharein.
6.  **Slip Download karein:** Payment hone ke baad apni appointment slip download kar lein aur use hospital lekar jayein.

**Iske fayde:**
*   Aapko hospital mein lambi line mein khade hone ki zaroorat nahi padti.
*   Aap pehle se hi apna samay aur doctor ka din fix kar sakte hain.
*   Yeh paperless aur asaan tareeka hai.

**Dhyan dein:** OPD mein jane par apni appointment slip aur apna Aadhaar card zaroor sath rakhein.

entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, online registration is mandatory. You can use one of the following methods:

*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, and follow the steps to book your department, date, and time. You will need to pay a ₹50 fee and download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection process as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to the hospital. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, and pay the ₹50 fee to collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM; Closed on Sundays.
*   **Referrals:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Arrival:** The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. For your safety, please avoid sharing personal details like health records or ID numbers in this chat.
